native_cumulative.sql_sample: SELECT SR.RESERVATION_ID,SR.SOURCE_LINE_ID,SR.SOURCE_DOC_TYPE,SR.SOURCE_DOC_ID,SR.RESERVATION_VERSION,SR.BASE_QTY,SR.BASE_UOM,RR.UID_POLETA,RR.CELL,RR.REMAIN FROM RRL_STOCK_RESERVATION SR JOIN RRL_REMAINS RR ON RR.UID_POLETA=SR.UID_PALLET AND RR.CELL=SR.CELL JOIN RRL_PALLETS PP ON PP.UID_PALLET=SR.UID_PALLET JOIN RRL_CELLS CC ON CC.CELL=SR.CELL LEFT JOIN RRL_PROD_BATCH_READY_V BR ON BR.PROD_BATCH_ID=PP.PROD_BATCH_ID WHERE SR.CUSTOMER_ORDER_ID=:B8 AND SR.ARTICUL=:B7 AND SR.RESERVATION_KIND='HARD' AND SR.RESERVATION_DOMAIN='PICKING' AND SR.STATUS IN('ACTIVE','ALLOCATED','PICKING') AND SR.BASE_QTY>0 AND SR.BASE_UOM=:B6 AND CC.WARE_ID=:B5 AND (:B4 IS NULL OR (SR.UID_PALLET=:B4 AND SR.SOURCE_LINE_ID=:B3 )) AND NVL(CC.BLOCKED_FOR_REMAINS,0)=0 AND NVL(CC.BLOCKED_FOR_POPOLNENIE,0)=0 AND NVL(BR.IS_SHIPMENT_ALLOWED,1)=1 AND ((:B2 IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM RRL_CASE_CARRIER_LOT H WHERE H.

SELECT SR.RESERVATION_ID,SR.UID_PALLET,SR.CELL,SR.BASE_QTY,SR.BASE_UOM,S.REMAIN,S.STOCK_VERSION,P.EXPIRY_DATE FROM RRL_STOCK_RESERVATION SR JOIN RRL_REMAINS S ON S.UID_POLETA=SR.UID_PALLET AND S.CELL=SR.CELL JOIN RRL_PALLETS P ON P.UID_PALLET=SR.UID_PALLET WHERE SR.SOURCE_DOC_TYPE='PICK_WAVE' AND SR.SOURCE_DOC_ID=:B7 AND SR.SOURCE_LINE_ID=:B6 AND SR.CUSTOMER_ORDER_ID=:B5 AND SR.RESERVATION_KIND='HARD' AND SR.STATUS IN('ACTIVE','ALLOCATED','PICKING') AND SR.CELL=:B4 AND P.ARTICUL=:B1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM RRL_CASE_CARRIER_LOT H WHERE H.LOT_UID=SR.UID_PALLET) AND RRL_STOCK_ELIGIBILITY.REASON(SR.UID_PALLET,SR.CELL,:B3 ,LEAST(:B2 ,SR.BASE_QTY),NULL,NULL,'PICK',SR.RESERVATION_ID,:B1 ) IS NULL ORDER BY P.EXPIRY_DATE NULLS LAST,SR.UID_PALLET,SR.RESERVATION_ID FETCH FIRST 201 ROWS ONLY

SELECT C.WARE_ID,S.REMAIN,S.HARD_RESERVED_BASE,S.BASE_UOM,P.ARTICUL,P.EXPIRY_DATE,P.PRODUCED_DATE, GREATEST(NVL(C.BLOCKED_FOR_REMAINS,0),NVL(C.BLOCKED_FOR_POPOLNENIE,0)),NVL(C.IS_SYSTEM,0), NVL(RULE.SOURCE_PICK_MODE,'AFTER_PUTAWAY'),NVL(RULE.MIN_SHELF_DAYS,0),NVL(BR.IS_SHIPMENT_ALLOWED,1) FROM RRL_REMAINS S JOIN RRL_PALLETS P ON P.UID_PALLET=S.UID_POLETA JOIN RRL_CELLS C ON C.CELL=S.CELL LEFT JOIN RRL_RECEIPT_SKU_RULE RULE ON RULE.WARE_ID=C.WARE_ID AND RULE.ARTICUL=P.ARTICUL LEFT JOIN RRL_PROD_BATCH_READY_V BR ON BR.PROD_BATCH_ID=P.PROD_BATCH_ID WHERE S.UID_POLETA=:B2 AND S.CELL=:B1

SELECT H.LOT_UID,S.CELL,S.REMAIN,S.STOCK_VERSION,S.BASE_UOM,P.ARTICUL,H.CASE_PICK_LINE_ID FROM RRL_CASE_CARRIER_LOT H JOIN RRL_REMAINS S ON S.UID_POLETA=H.LOT_UID JOIN RRL_PALLETS P ON P.UID_PALLET=H.LOT_UID WHERE H.CASE_PICK_TASK_ID=:B1 AND S.REMAIN>0 ORDER BY H.LOT_UID,S.CELL FETCH FIRST 201 ROWS ONLY

select count(*)from RRL_CASE_PICK_LINE l         left join(select h.CASE_PICK_LINE_ID,sum(s.REMAIN) QTY from RRL_CASE_CARRIER_LOT h           join RRL_REMAINS s on s.UID_POLETA=h.LOT_UID where h.CASE_PICK_TASK_ID=:id           group by h.CASE_PICK_LINE_ID)p on p.CASE_PICK_LINE_ID=l.CASE_PICK_LINE_ID         where l.CASE_PICK_TASK_ID=:id and nvl(p.QTY,0)!=nvl(l.PICKED_QTY,0)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RRL_WMS_HU_LINK WHERE ACTIVE_FLAG=1 AND (CHILD_PALLET_UID=:B1 OR CHILD_CASE_TASK_ID IN(SELECT CASE_PICK_TASK_ID FROM RRL_CASE_CARRIER_LOT WHERE LOT_UID=:B1 ))

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RRL_RECEIPT_SKU_RULE R LEFT JOIN RRL_RECEIPT_CELL_RULE CR ON CR.CELL=:B2 AND CR.WARE_ID=:B1 WHERE R.WARE_ID=:B1 AND R.ARTICUL=:B3 AND ((R.TEMP_MIN IS NOT NULL AND(CR.TEMP_MIN IS NULL OR CR.TEMP_MIN<R.TEMP_MIN)) OR(R.TEMP_MAX IS NOT NULL AND(CR.TEMP_MAX IS NULL OR CR.TEMP_MAX>R.TEMP_MAX)))

SELECT ID FROM RRL_SBORKA_PALLETS WHERE NVL(CONDITION,0)<2 AND ID IN( SELECT LEGACY_SBORKA_PALLET_ID FROM RRL_CASE_PICK_TASK WHERE CASE_PICK_TASK_ID IN( SELECT CASE_PICK_TASK_ID FROM RRL_CASE_CARRIER_LOT WHERE LOT_UID IN(SELECT U FROM JSON_TABLE(:B1 ,'$[*]' COLUMNS(U VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$')))) UNION SELECT LEGACY_SBORKA_PALLET_ID FROM RRL_CUSTOMER_ORDER_FULFILLMENT WHERE PICKED_PALLET_UID IN(SELECT U FROM JSON_TABLE(:B1 ,'$[*]' COLUMNS(U VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$')))) ORDER BY ID

SELECT PARENT_UID,LEVEL DEPTH,CONNECT_BY_ISCYCLE CYCLIC FROM RRL_WMS_HU_LINK START WITH (CHILD_PALLET_UID=:B2 OR CHILD_CASE_TASK_ID=:B1 ) AND ACTIVE_FLAG=1 CONNECT BY NOCYCLE PRIOR PARENT_UID=CHILD_PALLET_UID AND ACTIVE_FLAG=1

SELECT HU_LINK_ID,PARENT_UID,LEVEL DEPTH,CONNECT_BY_ISCYCLE CYCLIC FROM RRL_WMS_HU_LINK START WITH ACTIVE_FLAG=1 AND (CHILD_PALLET_UID=:B1 OR CHILD_CASE_TASK_ID IN (SELECT CASE_PICK_TASK_ID FROM RRL_CASE_CARRIER_LOT WHERE LOT_UID=:B1 )) CONNECT BY NOCYCLE PRIOR PARENT_UID=CHILD_PALLET_UID AND ACTIVE_FLAG=1
SELECT COUNT(*)FROM RRL_WMS_HU_LINK WHERE CHILD_CASE_TASK_ID=:B1 AND ACTIVE_FLAG=1
